description: This file defines the SnowDeviceManagementClient class, which extends AwsClient and provides methods to interact with AWS Snow Device Management service, including operations like creating, describing, listing, tagging, and untagging devices and tasks.

classes.name: SnowDeviceManagementClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with AWS Snow Device Management service, extending AwsClient.

methods.name: cancelTask
methods.description: Method to cancel a task in Snow Device Management.

methods.name: createTask
methods.description: Creates a new device management task.

methods.name: describeDevice
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific device.

methods.name: describeDeviceEc2Instances
methods.description: Gets details about EC2 instances associated with devices.

methods.name: describeExecution
methods.description: Provides details about a specific execution.

methods.name: describeTask
methods.description: Gets details about a specific task.

methods.name: listDeviceResources
methods.description: Lists resources associated with a device.

methods.name: listDevices
methods.description: Lists devices managed by the service.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags attached to a resource.
